title: Post-Processing & Upscaling / TSR Overhead
fix_rationale: Post-processing passes, upscaling filters (TSR/DLSS/FSR), Bloom, or Depth of Field are taking excessive GPU duration.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) during post-processing and upscaling.

fixes.text: Adjust TSR history screen percentage or resolution scale (r.ScreenPercentage, r.TSR.History.ScreenPercentage).
Lower Depth of Field and Motion Blur quality in scalability settings (r.DepthOfFieldQuality 0).
Lower Bloom quality or switch to standard Gaussian bloom (r.BloomQuality).

verify: Adjust r.ScreenPercentage or r.TSR.History.ScreenPercentage and verify post-process duration drops.
